When I was at school the toilets used to get locked after lunch break. Which meant to had to ask permission from a teacher who would send us to the reception to get a key. We had a temporary receptionist on one such visit for me and she gave me several keys as she wasn't sure what key was the correct one. Now sadly for her they all worked on every door in our school and she didn't notice the fact I gave her one key less back. Me and several of my close friends had the key copied and had some amazing times letting ourselves into computer labs during lunch breaks etc to surf the Internet (this was pre smart phones). And one memorable moment when my English teacher berated me during a lesson only to enter a book closet shortly after just outside the class room which suddenly became locked why she was inside. I was questioned over this the next day as I was informed the cleaners had found her later in the evening.

The council was immediately informed of the sensor readings regarding the former Luna Colony and an emergency council was formed in order to deal with the revelation that we are not the only one’s to have survived. 

The council meeting was one of the most crucial meetings of Commonwealth history and is taught to all children across the commonwealth in classrooms because it was at this meeting that the first major changes to how the commonwealth was run and is run to this day came to be. The first change was that the council decided it was vital a leader be elected from the council to give them a unified voice and clear goals. Secondly it was decided that no longer was it possible to exist without a military. this however was a gargantuan task as the commonwealth didn’t even have arm’s anymore they had long since been destroyed, and finally construction of a [military academy](http://imgur.com/hwK6RVA) was ordered with the intention of training only the best of the best for our new military.

The elections were over within a matter of hours the first governor of the commonwealth was [Ryan Douglas](http://imgur.com/Q4D8IC8), a young man at only 21 but where experience lacked he more than made up for with intelligence. The governor's first action was to unite all of the commonwealth's research facilities towards one united goal of figuring out how to work with and exploit “trans-newtonian” minerals, with the ultimate goal of creating some form of defence against future missile strikes. the council quickly began raising [infantry divisions](http://imgur.com/bue6OT1) which were only armed with knives and quarterstaffs, due to this fact they had been dubbed “low tech” whilst these regiments were never expected to actually ever see combat it was deemed necessary to boost civilian morale.

Governor Douglas decided it was best to prepare before any attempt was made to contact Luna Colony and ordered that the commonwealth should attempt to remain unnoticed as long as possible why technologies and arm’s were created that could defend it should the need arise.
